<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AccidentNotification" name="Accident, near-miss or risk notification"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Insured" name="Insured person" processRef="Proc_Insured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Employer" name="Employer (incl. self-employed person)" processRef="Proc_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_AccidentInsurer" name="Accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_School" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Proc_School"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Student" name="Student or schoolchild" processRef="Proc_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="StartEvent_Notification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PrivateReport" name="Written accident report" sourceRef="Task_PrivateReport" targetRef="Part_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PrivateFatality" name="Fatality report within three days" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Part_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReportLabour" name="Report fatality or serious injury" sourceRef="Task_ReportLabour" targetRef="Part_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EmployerReportInsurer" name="Report within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportInsurer" targetRef="Part_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SchoolReportInsurer" name="Report within five days in triplicate" sourceRef="Task_ReportTriplicate" targetRef="Part_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StudentReportDirectorate" name="Report accident" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Part_Directorate"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Proc_Insured" name="Insured person" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Accident" name="Accident or near miss occurs">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Identify" name="Identify reportable event">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_I3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateCheck" name="Private insurance applies?" default="Flow_PrivateNo">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_I3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrivateYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrivateNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateReport" name="Report accident in writing to private insurer immediately">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrivateYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FatalCheck" name="Fatality?" default="Flow_NotFatal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FatalYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotFatal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateFatality" name="Report fatality to private insurer within three days">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FatalYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PF</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FatalReported" name="Fatality reported to private insurer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PF</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReportedPrivate" name="Accident reported to private insurer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotFatal</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoPrivate" name="No private insurance report required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrivateNo</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Accident" targetRef="Task_Identify"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I2" sourceRef="Task_Identify" targetRef="Task_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I3" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck" targetRef="Task_PrivateReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${privateInsuranceApplies}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateCheck" targetRef="End_NoPrivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P2" sourceRef="Task_PrivateReport" targetRef="Gateway_FatalCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FatalYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FatalCheck" targetRef="Task_PrivateFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${fatality}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotFatal" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FatalCheck" targetRef="End_ReportedPrivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PF" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatality" targetRef="End_FatalReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Proc_Employer" name="Employer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Notification" name="Accident, near-miss or risk notification received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Notification" messageRef="Msg_AccidentNotification"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordDetails" name="Record incident details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SeverityCheck" name="Fatality or serious injury?" default="Flow_SevNo">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SevYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SevNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmergencyCheck" name="Already reported to emergency services?" default="Flow_EmNo">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SevYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EmYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EmNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportLabour" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate immediately">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EmNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_L2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LIMerge" name="Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SevNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EmYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_L2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsurerCheck" name="Fatality or unable to work for three days?" default="Flow_InsNo">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInsurer" name="Report to accident insurance provider within five days">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsMerge" name="Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Documented" name="Accident information gathered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Notification" targetRef="Task_RecordDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E2" sourceRef="Task_RecordDetails" targetRef="Gateway_SeverityCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SevYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SeverityCheck" targetRef="Gateway_EmergencyCheck">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isFatalOrSeriousInjury}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SevNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SeverityCheck" targetRef="Gateway_LIMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyCheck" targetRef="Gateway_LIMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reportedToEmergencyServices}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyCheck" targetRef="Task_ReportLabour"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_L2" sourceRef="Task_ReportLabour" targetRef="Gateway_LIMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E3" sourceRef="Gateway_LIMerge" targetRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck" targetRef="Task_ReportInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${fatalityOrIncapacityThreeDays}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurerCheck" targetRef="Gateway_InsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R2" sourceRef="Task_ReportInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_InsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E4" sourceRef="Gateway_InsMerge" targetRef="End_Documented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Proc_School" name="School, educational facility or university" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" name="Work accident with insured person injured or killed occurs">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportTriplicate" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider within five days (in triplicate)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SchoolReported" name="Accident reported">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SchoolAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportTriplicate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S2" sourceRef="Task_ReportTriplicate" targetRef="End_SchoolReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Proc_Student" name="Student or schoolchild" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StudentAccident" name="Accident of student or schoolchild occurs">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ST1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ST1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ST2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StudentReported" name="Accident reported">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ST2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ST1" sourceRef="StartEvent_StudentAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ST2" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="End_StudentReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EmployerReportInsurer" name="Report within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportInsurer" targetRef="Part_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SchoolReportInsurer" name="Report within five days in triplicate" sourceRef="Task_ReportTriplicate" targetRef="Part_AccidentInsurer"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_I1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Accident" targetRef="Task_InformEmployer"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WorkAccidentCheck" name="Work accident (not only near miss or risk)?" default="Flow_NotAccident">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WAYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotAccident</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SeverityCheck" name="Fatality or serious injury?" default="Flow_SevNo">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WAYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SevYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SevNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmergencyCheck" name="Already reported to emergency services?" default="Flow_EmNo">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SevYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EmYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EmNo</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CoverYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CoverNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OutcomeCheck" name="Killed or unable to work for three days?" default="Flow_OutNo">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OutYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OutNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInsurer" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider within five days">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CoverNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OutNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_R2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_E4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NearMiss" name="Near miss or risk recorded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotAccident</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Documented" name="Accident information gathered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_E4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Ann_SelfEmployed">
      <bpmn:text>Self-employed persons also report accidents involving themselves to the accident insurance provider in good time.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Assoc_SelfEmployed" sourceRef="Ann_SelfEmployed" targetRef="Task_ReportInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Notification" targetRef="Task_RecordDetails"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotAccident" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_WorkAccidentCheck" targetRef="End_NearMiss"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SevYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SeverityCheck" targetRef="Gateway_EmergencyCheck">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${isFatalOrSeriousInjury}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SevNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SeverityCheck" targetRef="Gateway_LIMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyCheck" targetRef="Gateway_LIMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reportedToEmergencyServices}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyCheck" targetRef="Task_ReportLabour"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_L2" sourceRef="Task_ReportLabour" targetRef="Gateway_LIMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E3" sourceRef="Gateway_LIMerge" targetRef="Gateway_InsuredCover"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CoverYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuredCover" targetRef="Gateway_OutcomeCheck">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${personWithAccidentInsurance}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CoverNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuredCover" targetRef="Gateway_InsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OutcomeCheck" targetRef="Task_ReportInsurer">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OutcomeCheck" targetRef="Gateway_InsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R2" sourceRef="Task_ReportInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_InsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_E4" sourceRef="Gateway_InsMerge" targetRef="End_Documented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Proc_School" name="School, educational facility or university" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S2" sourceRef="Task_ReportTriplicate" targetRef="End_SchoolReported"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Proc_Student" name="Student or schoolchild" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OutcomeYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OutcomeNo</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInsurer" name="Report to accident insurance provider within five days">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OutcomeYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_R2</bpmn:outgoing>

rules.instruction: When the description states that, after a decision or condition, one outcome requires an extra activity before the process continues, while the other outcome skips that activity, and both outcomes then lead to the same later step: Model an exclusive gateway at the decision point with one outgoing flow to the extra activity under the condition where it applies and a second outgoing flow under the complementary condition that bypasses it. Connect the end of the extra activity and the bypass flow into one merging exclusive gateway, and connect that merge to the shared later step. Do not connect the extra activity directly to the shared later step, and do not omit the bypass branch.
rules.situation: the description attaches a notification duty to an event only when the event falls into a stated severity category, or only when no other authority has yet been informed of that event, so the duty is skipped for events outside that condition

rules.instruction: When the description makes a reporting duty applicable only when several separately stated facts hold, such as an outcome, the affected person's insurance cover, or a prior report by another party, and each fact is given in its own clause: Model one exclusive gateway for each separately stated fact, in the order the description gives them. Phrase each gateway question so that it names only that one fact in the description's own terms. Route the branch where the fact holds to the reporting task, with its deadline in that task's label, and route the other branch to the next gateway or to the end. Do not merge two facts into one question, and do not drop a fact the description states as a precondition for a report.
rules.situation: the description makes a reporting duty applicable only when several separately stated facts hold, such as an outcome, the affected person's insurance cover, or a prior report by another party, and each fact is given in its own clause

rules.instruction: When the description requires an additional notification for a subset of occurrences, selected by a severity condition such as a fatality, and that notification must still be sent even though an earlier notification of the same occurrence already exists, often with its own deadline: Model an exclusive gateway after the earlier notification step. Give one outgoing flow, conditioned on the subset condition, to a separate notification task that carries the stricter deadline, and a second flow for occurrences outside the subset that skips that task. Join both flows again with an exclusive merge gateway before the next step. Do not omit the additional notification, and do not make it unconditional when the description limits it to the subset.
rules.situation: the description requires an additional notification for a subset of occurrences, selected by a severity condition such as a fatality, and that notification must still be sent even though an earlier notification of the same occurrence already exists, often with its own deadline

rules.instruction: When the description makes a report to an authority depend both on a severity criterion and on whether another authority has already been notified of the same event: Model each requirement the description attaches to the report as its own exclusive gateway, in the order the description gives. Use one gateway that checks whether the other authority has already been notified, and a separate gateway that checks the severity criterion, each with a question worded from the description. Route the report task only from the branch where every stated requirement is met, and route the remaining branch around it, so the report is reached only when the other notification is absent and the severity criterion holds.
rules.situation: the description makes a report to an authority depend both on a severity criterion and on whether another authority has already been notified of the same event

rules.instruction: When the description states an initial report for a set of events, and then states a follow-up report with a different deadline for a narrower subset of those same events, even though the initial report has already been made: Model the initial report as its own task. Then place an exclusive gateway whose question asks whether the event belongs to the narrower subset, phrased with the subset as the description names it. Route the yes flow to a separate task that carries out the follow-up report with its own stated deadline, and route the no flow onward to the next step. Do not fold the follow-up report into the initial report task, and do not merge the subset question with the question that decides the initial report.
rules.situation: the description states an initial report for a set of events, and then states a follow-up report with a different deadline for a narrower subset of those same events, even though the initial report has already been made
